'''Mirana Fioro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Hapan]] con artist who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Fioro specialized at performing scams while in disguise as a Hapan [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]], and circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], she entered in the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] at the behest of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]]. Darga had made a deal with the Empire to supply resources for use on the [[Sarlacc Project]] and Fioro's task was to covertly received Darga's payment from [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Armen Arandis]], an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who was participating in the tournament.
